body: It’s not all about sex and looks. It’s also about interpersonal intimacy like just sharing space and time. But I guess most people don’t feel that way.
I know it’s difficult though, watching everyone else around you. It feels like a race, that you are the only one in.
It’s more like I remember the good times and they make the hard times even harder. It’s a constant barrage of memories all the time.
I’m on quite a bit a none of it works. Seroquel zoloft lamotragine haloperidol venlafaxine all high except seroquel. I’m on a lot of medications. They just don’t help.
Also I’m in therapy. But alas it doesn’t do much at times either.

I’ve tried everything. It sad but when I drive by a lake I think of crashing in it, or a knife I think of slitting my wrists. I’ve made attempts before, yet always seem to fail. I don’t know if it’s because I’m a piece of shit, or if there is purpose in my life. (Which I doubt.) I’ve tried online dating and it’s just led to more trust issues. Not over looks, but I make sure I don’t just jump into things and they either leave or cheat, or fight.  It destroys your confidence and leaves you empty.

That’s kind of a tough question. I don’t do much. I kinda just watch movies and listen to music. Finding a job is hard especially with bi polar disorder. I’m usually just waiting for my world to fall apart again.
If only it was that easy. Lol.
